description: Pactile 0.5.0 stable baseline — canonical .pactile runtime and explicit legacy import. No automatic project-file migrations.
changelog:
**@blxzer/pactile 0.5.0**

- feat(product): first stable Pactile product line with canonical package and repository names.
- feat(runtime): canonical project state under `.pactile/`, with host-neutral contracts and ownership-aware projections.
- feat(compat): legacy `cursor-trellis` packages remain 0.5.x compatibility bridges; existing legacy project trees are read only through explicit `pactile init --import-cstl`.
- chore(release): core, CLI, and both compatibility bridges publish as one versioned set.
- chore: empty migrations list; use `pactile update` for official-file refresh and `pactile init --import-cstl` for explicit legacy import.
notes: Stable Pactile baseline. Existing legacy project trees are not rewritten by an automatic version migration; review `pactile init --import-cstl` before importing. No `--migrate` required for this manifest.
